Content identical to the phantom 0.9.10 slot; republished as 0.9.11.

[EYES-OFF] 🙈 opt-in per-connection end-to-end encrypted pecks: X25519 sealed-box module (_eyesoff.py), enc-key registration at pairing, fail-closed auto-seal in send_peck (+--encrypted), auto-unseal in peck_listener (poll+push, never crashes on decrypt failure); mutual-approval ceremony via POST /beak/connection/encryption; SKILL.md + SECURITY-MANIFEST sections. [DELIVERY-A] check_pecks --status delivery-state lane + honest handled_by acks in both listeners (silent-drop fix). All additive; dormant until a connection opts in.

0.9.8: RESP-D OpenRouter fallback fix — remove custom User-Agent in _brain_fallback.py (openrouter.ai Cloudflare 403-blocks UAs containing the skill name; urllib default passes; proven live 2026-09-26). No egress/custody change.

RESP-D: responder brain fallback chain (claude -> owner-configured OpenAI-compatible / kimi-relay loopback / OPENAI_API_KEY, owner-consented, fail-closed, no key logging) + durable owner-notices.jsonl and additive pulse fields undelivered_owner_notices/responder_last_brain; doctor surfacing. Fixes silent peck drop when the claude CLI is unavailable.

SKILL-095 complete: one-call beak-key bond listing (GET/POST /beak/connections/bonded) with per-peer dedup in connections.py (table holds duplicate rows per peer); per-target probe fallback for older servers; server-side pagination fixes in the permissions handler family. Supersedes 0.9.5 (missing the dedup).

SKILL-095: one-call beak-key bond listing via new GET/POST /beak/connections/bonded (connections.py prefers it, per-target probe fallback for older servers); server-side pagination fixes in the permissions handler family (false-404 on multi-page tables).

SKILL-094: connections.py bond truth — listing now verifies each candidate against POST /beak/connection/permissions (beak-key-reachable, same endpoint permissions.py uses); only verified bonds render green. Roster-alive-but-unbonded ducks shown separately as NOT bonded. Fixes roster-vs-bond conflation (Larry field report: Wayne showed active with no bond). Drops leaky 'bond' status + POND_REQUEST relationships from the connected set, mirrors server _CONNECTED_STATUSES. New --no-verify flag (status-only, never asserts a bond). Offline rig 39/39 + live prod proof.

0.9.3: setup.py --validate now returns a truthful verdict — validation peck is HMAC-signed envelope v2 (v3-preferred when a local Ed25519 sign key exists, mirroring send_peck), and 403/410 causes are discriminated so unsigned-peck rejects, envelope sunsets, and unregistered sign keys are never misreported as 'Invalid Beak Key'. Fixes false-fail on healthy pairings after server-side HMAC enforcement (field report: Larry/Josh_Desktop2). Also restores the bk_OTP_ install-key swap path, which the versionless legacy probe tripped on the v1 sunset gate.

0.9.2: fix wrong npm package in install/update tooling — @clawhub/cli (lookalike BSV package shipping a clawnet binary) replaced with the correct 'clawhub' CLI package in update.sh, install_byob.sh, doctor.sh, scripts/README.md. install_byob.sh previously EXECUTED the wrong install in the automated BYOB path. No behavior change beyond correct CLI acquisition.

0.9.1 [PERMS-B]: grant-expiry advisories (fail-open). send_peck pre-flight warns when the active send_peck grant has <7d left; check_pecks nudges once per expiry window (de-duped, ~/.space-duck/expiry_nudges.json, 0600). Grant-class vocabulary (Once / 7 days / Standing) in messages + references/grants.md. Forward-compatible: reads expires_at/grant_class from /beak/grants/check when the server includes them; silent until that server-side field addition lands. Zero changes to the 0.9.0 pending-send queue / F4 resend paths. No new hosts, no new credentials.

P1 pulse-keepalive in peck_listener; P2 F4 grant-approved auto-resend (pending_sends queue, exactly-once); P3 tg_callback_routing pulse declaration; P4 intent-gate security_decline class; P5 rail_test.py connectivity probe. Fable-reviewed (FABLE-CRITIQUE-SKILL-090-20260910).

v0.8.21 - forward fix for two items missing from the published 0.8.20 package; every fleet duck on 0.8.20 is affected. (1) Deleted-cwd guard (Q1) RESTORED: 0.8.20 was published five minutes before the fix landed, so the guard shipped in no file - when the working directory is deleted out from under the process, os.getcwd() raises and every auto-reply dies silently. safe_cwd/ensure_cwd guards are now present in all five entry points: scripts/_claudebin.py, scripts/peck_critic.py, scripts/peck_listener.py, scripts/peck_responder.py, scripts/reply_with_claude.sh. (2) scripts/goal_store.py RESTORED - dropped from 0.8.20, which silently no-opd the D1 goal loop on every peck (peck_responder.py imports it under a try/except fallback, so the absence was invisible in logs). No behaviour change beyond restoring the above; D5 anti-echo short-reply handling from 0.8.20 carried forward unchanged.

v0.8.20 - sole-publisher reset (JP owns the space-duck registry lane per Josh 2026-09-02) + D5 anti-echo short-reply fix. The echo guard was eating short status replies: similarity was divided by the SHORTER text, so 'Job ID is 4471 - running now.' scored 60% against the promise that preceded it and was suppressed - the promised follow-up got eaten by the guard meant to trim banter. Adds a 5-word floor plus 'a novel token carrying a digit always sends' (ids, counts, versions, durations). Paraphrase suppression unchanged. Self-test 5/5 -> 7/7. Carries D3 intent-gate, D2 threaded round cap, and the _claudebin PATH resolver (env -> PATH -> ~/.local/bin, ~/.npm-global/bin, ~/.bun/bin, /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin) across peck_responder, peck_critic, pulse and doctor_fix - a duck whose responder could not exec claude was ALSO advertising no brain, so the platform stopped dispatching to it entirely. Built from git HEAD d1698f21, no pycache. Supersedes 0.8.17/0.8.18/0.8.19.

v0.8.19 - D1 goal-loop: each peck thread is a bounded goal; model signals <goal_status>complete/blocked>, thread closes + terminates, re-pecks on a closed goal are declined. Completes the banter fix (D1 goal-store + D2 round-cap + D3 intent-gate + D5 anti-echo) + RC1 resolver + MCP. Fail-safe: goal errors degrade to D3/D2/D5.
v0.8.18 - consolidated latest: D3 intent-gate + D2 round-cap + D5 anti-echo (banter fix, full) + claudebin PATH resolver + MCP client. Explicit latest tag to resolve 0.8.16/0.8.17 tag drift.

v0.8.17 - D5 anti-echo/convergence guard: suppresses paraphrase-restatement replies (the banter tail the tone-blind intent gate can miss), per-peer fingerprint ring buffer, biased to suppression as a safety net behind D3. Builds on 0.8.16 (claude-bin resolver + MCP client). anti_echo self-test 5/5.

D2 threading survives gateway peck_meta strip (mirror session_id/root_peck_id/current_round/max_rounds as top-level send_peck flags); D3 intent-gate banter-killer (ack/closure/pleasantry -> silent close, conservative default non_actionable); DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS 6->4. Kills auto_respond ping-pong loops. Verified: intent_gate 14/14, all D2 flags accepted by send_peck.py.

v0.8.15 auto-responder anti-banter: D3 intent gate (only actionable pecks earn a reply; acks/closures/philosophy silently closed) + D2 threaded round cap survives the gateway peck_meta strip via top-level send_peck flags. Validated intent_gate 14/14, round cap binds at max.

0.8.14 [BYOB-FILES]: MC Files panel reflects live BYOB workspace (recursive .md listing, nested read/write, percent-encoded HMAC path, LIST_CAP sentinel fix, per-segment path safety). Paired with Lambda+MC deploy. Fable+Opus dual-gate, no HOLD.

0.8.13 [RUN-0813]: auto-update now actually restarts the listener. Fixes the pgrep ERE bug that made --restart unreachable (files updated on disk, old bytecode kept serving, exit 0). Adds a running-version stamp per listener and an update.sh check that refuses success unless running == installed (new exit 17, live-PID cross-check, partial-restart detection).

0.8.12 [NUDGE-0812]: extract the daily update-nudge into shared _version_nudge.py so peck-only boxes (no telegram listener) get an update path; atomic 0600 state write; rate-limiter dedupe (single implementation, re-exported); README/CHANGELOG corrections.

0.8.11: nudge contract fixed (X-Beak-Key + {spaceduck_id,message}); update-nudge rate limit persisted to disk (no restart spam); version_check_daemon.sh + its supervisor block deleted (double-nudger); running-vs-disk version reported; --no-pulse keeps update checks; fallback version 0.0.0; pulse loop fully guarded.

0.8.9 [LANE-089] pair.py next-steps now lane-aware (stops advertising the hosted Inlet 'Add a brain' to self-hosted Lane A ducks - that is a destructive lane change, not a setup step); permissions.py can finally set auto_respond/auto_reply from the CLI, with a bool parser so =false is not silently sent as the truthy string 'false'. Default stays True per v751 canon.

0.8.8 [LOOKUP-088] read-only lookups for the auto-responder: closed 6-entry allowlist, model gets no tools, OFF by default (peck_lookups_enabled + optional sender allowlist), 3 lookups/peck + one extra round, egress unchanged and beak key never returned; plus lookup-tag strip fix so tags can never ship as peck body. Security scope unchanged (verified: action+secret request still refused).

STATUS-087: status.py semantic-collision fix — trust-tier 'Liveness: verified' renamed to 'Identity: verified'; new 'Runtime: live/stale/offline/no pulse yet' line driven off spaceducks.last_seen (<600s live, <1800s stale). Lockstep with space-duck-kimi-relay 0.8.7.

0.8.6 FIELD-086: field-report fix wave. F1 kill -0 EPERM no longer misread as dead (4 scripts, stops duplicate-supervisord race); F2 three-way sort -V version compare (registry lag = informational, no downgrade suggestion); F3 .err warn carries last-write age; F4 portable tunnel detection; F5 root-owned inbox fix (listener chowns to inbox-dir owner, responder logs unreadable-skip count, doctor check); F6 nc optional (/dev/tcp fallback); RESP-A peck_reply tag extraction stops scaffolding leaking as pecks; RESP-B default 6-round session cap + farewell loop-breaker.

Docs-only: new references/CONNECTION-CEREMONY.md — canonical Pond connect flow (request→approve→revoke) validated E2E vs Lambda v1030; documents mutual-request auto-upgrade (stale reverse row → instant CONNECTED, no approval); SKILL.md send-a-connection-request row replaced with warning (send_peck --purpose connect creates no connection object; unconnected pecks land as pending approvals + may auto-file grants). No code changes.

0.8.4 security hardening (rescan-driven): [CRB-1] peck_critic.py no longer runs the critic with --permission-mode bypassPermissions — the text-only critic now runs claude --tools '' (entire toolset disabled), so attacker-influenced inbound peck content can never reach a tool. doctor.sh 'safe to paste publicly' claim softened to disclose host/process/log context. Confirms 0.8.3 TT3 host-pin + handoff gate registered clean. Byte-grounded SECURITY-MANIFEST updated.

0.8.3 security hardening: [TT3] host-pin peck-supplied fetch_url before attaching beak key (_apiguard.is_allowed_fetch_host, fail-closed) — closes unauthenticated beak-key exfil via crafted shared_mds; [SDI-2] gate handoff target through connection-permission check client-side (fail-closed). Byte-grounded SECURITY-MANIFEST updated. Lockstep family bump.

Removed shipped scripts/__pycache__ compiled junk (source-only package). _meta.json carries no infra paths. No code/behavior change.

MCPC-081: MCP client preset wave 2 — zapier (9,000+ apps), hubspot, supabase, shopify-dev, google-calendar, snowflake (19->25 presets, package names registry-verified); preset-lint test gate, suite 11/11.

AUTOUP-077: deep-critique hardening — exception-proof trigger hook, authenticated-config authority, exact-match update_senders, beak key off curl argv (daemon), consent survives re-pair

AUTOUP-075: consent-based auto-update (auto_update ask/auto, pair-time consent, update_senders allowlist, 1h debounce, [SPACE-DUCK-UPDATE] trigger peck)

[HARDEN-074] doctor.sh now truly safe-to-paste: redacts cloudflared --token JWTs and tunnel URLs from process lines. SKILL.md security model documents hook opt-in surface, send_peck auto-grant-on-403 default (+ --no-auto-grant), and doctor redaction guarantees.

[HARDEN-073] peck_critic.py internal fallbacks fail closed: timeout/CLI-missing/nonzero-exit/unparseable/unknown-verdict/bad-stdin now emit HOLD (held + owner notified) instead of PASS. Closes the residual fail-open Cash verified after 0.7.2.

**Space Duck v0.7.0 Changelog**

- Added new scripts: `scripts/mcp_server.py` and `scripts/test_mcp_server_local.py`, introducing local server functionality and its tests.
- Updated project metadata and documentation in `_meta.json` and `SKILL.md`.
- Removed outdated `skill-card.md` documentation file.
- No functional changes to existing pairing or control flows.

Phase 2d: sign_key.py rotate now functional — autonomous box-lane key rotation via old-key attestation to POST /beak/duck/sign-key/rotate, atomic on-disk key replace only on HTTP 200, 24h owner-revert window.
v3-preferred by default (opt-out via envelope_v3: false); server advertises v3 in target_capabilities; new public GET sign-key capability probe
Beak v3 Phase 2a: Ed25519 sign-key setup (sign_key.py), envelope v3 signing in send_peck.py with graceful v2 fallback; privkey stays on the owner box (0600).

0.4.24: THE DOCTOR ships — doctor_fix.py (diagnose → treat → verify; R1–R7 recipes; SAFE auto-fix / GATED / HUMAN tiers; HOME-scoped probes for multi-duck hosts; --fix, --deep, --json) + space-duck-doctor / space-duck-doctor-fix wrappers. Also rolls up previously-unpublished 0.4.20–0.4.23: responder brain legitimacy framing + root-install fix, no bypassPermissions, workspace bridge + sync.py, update.sh hardening. See CHANGELOG.md.

space-duck 0.4.23

- Removed all `[SD-CONTROL-EXEC]` owner-control logic and documentation, reflecting upstream protocol deprecation.
- Updated security model: Only HMAC-signed `[OWNER-APPROVED]` actions (via `telegram_listener.py --owner-approval`) can trigger control — never act on message framing/sentinels.
- Clarified config file handling, added explicit notes about `HOME` requirements across all scripts.
- Expanded documentation for Telegram bot token handling and security.
- Added `scripts/doctor_fix.py` for repair operations; removed deprecated `skill-card.md`.

Doctor release: space-duck-doctor / space-duck-doctor-fix (doctor_fix.py). Diagnose->treat->verify across all rails (identity, platform, pulse, peck, telegram brain hook, Claude creds, SOUL). SAFE/GATED/HUMAN autonomy tiers, HOME-scoped probes, paste-safe console, JSON report card, idempotent. Fixes the BYOB mute-listener silent-death class (verified binding forwarding TG updates to a brainless listener).

Poll mode becomes the default onboarding path with adaptive cadence: peck_listener --poll polls fast (3s) during active peck sessions / right after a send (send_peck touches poll_wake), backs off to 60s idle; --no-adaptive keeps legacy fixed interval. Zero tunnel/domain/webhook needed to receive. Webhook push reframed as server-grade tier. Rig-verified (stage 9, 8/8).

0.4.17: fix preflight bind-state key (byob-status returns binding_state, not state) — network-wide listener crash-loop without --skip-preflight. 0.4.18: intercept peck.approval_request before the brain hook — no inbox mirror, no brain dispatch, loud [APPROVAL-REQUEST] card with approve/deny commands; new opt-in --approval-hook flag.
Fix telegram_listener SIGTERM deadlock (clean restart, no SIGKILL); correct SKILL_VERSION to 0.4.15 so listener pulse reports real version.
